title: Light Velvety Kenyan Chicken Curry
description: A sweet and kid-friendly Kenyan dish featuring makrut lime leaves, made with sous-vide and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, this curry is a delicious and healthy option for the whole family.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 140 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine onion, ginger, garlic, and makrut lime leaves, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together curry powder, salt, black pepper, and brown sugar.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry mixture.
Add the blended onion mixture to the bowl and toss to combine.
Place the chicken mixture in a sous-vide bag and seal.
Cook the chicken in the sous-vide machine for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the chicken from the sous-vide machine and stir in the coconut milk.
Simmer the curry over low heat for 10 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the curry hot over rice or with naan bread.
